notes.title: Killed the bug!
notes.content:
There was a bug that froze the game in a certain interaction. I've found it, squeezed it, killed it. Now everything should work just fine.

Let me know if you encounter any issue.

I'm at your service. 

Cooking for you.

notes.title: Known bug
notes.content:
There's a known bug that freezes the game if you check the mask twice. It is not a game breaking issue, but I want to get to the bottom of this and fix it. Thanks for the patience.
Do not check the mask twice or the game will freeze. In the meantime I'll work on small fixes. Thank you for understanding. Game development is not easy, especially as a solo dev. 

I immensely appreciate your patience.

Another Dev Company
